packageRules.description: Policy: minor and patch updates auto-merge (squash) after the 3-day soak; majors never do.
Policy: GitHub Actions digest and pinDigest updates never auto-merge; they keep the 3-day soak (where a timestamp exists) and need review.
Update types that carry no release timestamp (digest, pin, replacement, bump, rollback, lockFileMaintenance) use the age gate only when a timestamp exists, so strict mode does not block them forever.
Group minor and patch dependency updates into one pull request
Keep major dependency updates in individual pull requests
